SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_1 AS PO_NO, KEY_2 AS PO_SEQ FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TR' AND TARGET = 'KRHWAS0031' AND KEY_9 = 'N' GROUP BY DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ, NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, NVL(A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, NVL(A.DS_DATE,' ') AS DS_DATE FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMTRXL B WHERE B.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND B.KEY_9 = 'N' AND B.TARGET = A.BUYER AND B.KEY_1 = A.PO_NO AND B.KEY_2 = A.PO_SEQ AND B.TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND B.KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND B.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$' ORDER BY A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, A.PO_SEQ
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_9 = 'N' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_9 = 'N' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND KEY_1 ='$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.PO_SEQ$'
